title: Vicky Donor
desc: Vicky, a young man, becomes a sperm donor at Dr. Baldev's fertility clinic, leading to humorous and heartwarming events as he navigates unexpected responsibilities.

title: Haisiyat
desc: Union leader Ram is also married to his boss. When there is a conflict between the management and the workers, Ram must decide if his duty lies towards his wife or towards his union and the workers.

title: Gold
desc: Tapan Das takes charge of India's hockey team post-independence and battles challenges and odds to lead them toward Olympic glory and bring pride to the nation.

title: Laadla
desc: Headstrong factory owner Sheetal marries Raju, the union leader, intending to crush his spirit and teach him a lesson, but their clash soon turns into a battle of wills.

title: Biwi No. 1
desc: Pooja, a loving wife, is devastated when her husband Prem falls for model Rupali. With support from friends, she confidently takes charge, making Prem realize her true worth.

title: Kick
desc: Devi, addicted to adventures, breaks up with Shaina, a psychiatrist in Warsaw. His daredevil pursuits test love, freedom, and the cost of chasing thrill over stability.

title: Double Dhamaal
desc: Four idlers dream of wealth by investing in buildings. Kabir cons them, leaving them broke. Determined, they set out to avenge their humiliation and reclaim dignity.

title: Silsila Hai Pyar Ka
desc: Vanshika, a simple young woman, is hired by a wealthy man to care for his son. Though the boy is spoiled at first, her presence slowly changes his outlook and their lives forever.

title: Pitaah
desc: Rudra, a poor labourer in a village ruled by the ruthless Thakur Avadh Narayan Singh, seeks justice after the Thakur's sons rape his minor daughter-vowing to hold them accountable.

title: Qaidi
desc: Suraj returns home to debt and auction. Widowed father and sister die. He kills two, goes to prison, escapes. Police guard Bansilal, shoot to kill Suraj on sight.

title: Commando - A One Man Army
desc: Karan, an Indian commando, is arrested by Chinese officials after a crash. Accused of spying, he must escape from their tough prison camp using all his skills.

title: Hamari Adhuri Kahani
desc: Five years after her husband vanishes, Vasudha rebuilds life as a single mother and finds love with Aarav. But when Hari unexpectedly returns, her world shatters as love and loyalty collide.

title: Cirkus
desc: Chaos erupts when two pairs of twins, separated at birth, unknowingly arrive in the same city. Their identical faces spark nonstop confusion, misunderstandings, and hilarious mayhem.

title: Khalnayak
desc: Inspector Ram arrests notorious criminal Ballu, but when Ballu escapes and ruins Ram's reputation, his fiancee Ganga sets a trap-only to face trouble when Ballu unexpectedly falls for her.

title: No Entry
desc: Kishan, a loyal husband, disapproves of his friend Prem's infidelity. But when introduced to Bobby, a prostitute, Kishan's morals are tested, leading to complications, secrets, and unexpected choices.

title: Ghayal Once Again
desc: Four teens accidentally film a murder involving a well-known figure and soon find themselves in danger. Ajay, a brave journalist, steps in to help them expose the killers.
